food_culture: Food is steady here, if not generous, and every household has enough with little left over.
commoner_resentments: Talk among neighbours turns, sooner or later, to what the Household Council has got wrong lately.
outsider_impressions: Nothing of weight is agreed here without the leave of the Household Council. Hunger is in the place, and a visitor sees it in thin faces. Nobody here heals by trade, and a visitor who falls ill must make do.
dawn_work: People go out to their work together at dawn, and no one strays far from the houses alone.

food_culture: Money is short, so meals are plain, but nobody goes without.
commoner_resentments: People put up with the Elder Council, but they expect little of it.
outsider_impressions: Visitors learn early that it pays to stay on good terms with the Elder Council. Hunger is in the place, and a visitor sees it in thin faces. Nobody stands guard here, and a visitor walks in unchallenged.
dawn_work: The first light goes to walking the fields to see how they stand, and then the day's work begins.

food_culture: The everyday fare is a simple stew and whatever else the day provides.
commoner_resentments: Many here feel that the Feudal Stewardship no longer listens to people like them.
outsider_impressions: Several powers carry weight here, and a visitor soon learns not to assume which one matters most. Visitors are told to keep to the roads and not to wander off them. Order here depends on people keeping it among themselves.
dawn_work: Before anyone goes out to work, each household looks to its own door and sees that all is as it was left.
